notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.15.2 prints `LINE NUMBER IS {integer-1 [ON NEXT PAGE] | PLUS integer-2}`. The 2002 forms are refused at 85: the integer-less NEXT PAGE operand (report-line-next-page-2002, VisitReportLineOperand), a second operand and the LINES/NUMBERS/ARE spellings (report-multi-line-2002) and the '+' symbol (report-plus-symbol-2002). Witnesses: 1985-FMT-XIII_3_15_2 and pb5242-line-next-page-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985: "LINE NUMBER IS { integer-1 [ ON NEXT PAGE ] | PLUS integer-2 }"; 2023: "{LINE NUMBER IS|LINE NUMBERS ARE|LINES ARE} {integer-1 [ON NEXT PAGE]|{PLUS|+} integer-2|ON NEXT PAGE} …". 2023 still accepts the 1985 forms but adds LINES/NUMBERS ARE, the + synonym, ON NEXT PAGE alone and repeated operands, so it accepts programs 1985 refuses.
